fields.label: Occurrence Number
fields.description: 1 = first time in the period, 2 = second… 0 = every time (a row with the exact number is used first).

fields.label: Maximum Minutes
fields.description: The row applies up to this many minutes (from the shift start when the policy says so, otherwise after the grace period). 0 means no maximum limit.

fields.label: Deduction Type
fields.options:
No Deduction
Minutes
Minutes × Multiplier
Hour
Quarter Day
Half Day
Full Day

fields.label: Deduction Value
fields.description: Minutes / hours / days to deduct; for Minutes × Multiplier, the multiplier applied to the minutes late or early.
